change.label: Open until midnight instead of 10 PM

summary: Extending hours to midnight increased revenue by 38.5 to 386.5 while reducing wait times from 4.7 to 2.5 minutes, but also raised walkouts from 13 to 17. The night crowd segment drove most of the gain with revenue climbing 47.5, offsetting a 17.5 decline from office workers who no longer visit at the later hours. Customer satisfaction improved slightly from 3 to 3.3, and rival visits dropped by 2, suggesting the extended window captured late-night demand that was previously going elsewhere. Menu performance shifted notably, with al pastor taco orders rising 6 and burrito orders up 4, while carnitas taco orders fell 9, indicating a change in late-night customer preferences compared to the daytime mix.
